---
title: Hello xfun
---

**xfun** is a grab bag of utility functions shared by packages maintained by
Yihui Xie. Run the code below to see the output, then change it to try your
own inputs.

## Strings

```{r}
library(xfun)

numbers_to_words(c(12, 305))
join_words(c('apples', 'pears', 'plums'))
format_bytes(123456789)
```

## Paths

```{r}
sans_ext(c('report.tar.gz', 'slides.Rmd'))
relative_path('docs/intro/index.md', 'docs')
```

## HTML and fenced blocks

```{r}
html_escape('<b>Tom & Jerry</b>')
cat(fenced_block('x = 1:10\nmean(x)', 'r'), sep = '\n')
```

Learn more at <https://github.com/yihui/xfun>.
